## Selected Work
1. **AI Learning Microservices (Cubbes, 130K+ students served):**
   - **Flashcards:** Backend microservice (Python, FastAPI, PyMuPDF) turning PDF course pages into structured question, answer, and hint cards with block processing and result reuse.
   - **Quiz:** Backend microservice (Python, FastAPI, AI) generating multiple-choice practice questions from course material grouped by difficulty.
   - **Mind Maps:** Backend microservice (Python, FastAPI, AI) extracting topics and relationships from course material into connected maps.
   - **Audio Podcast:** Backend microservice (Python, ElevenLabs, FFmpeg) generating two-speaker study podcasts from script generation through speech synthesis and audio assembly.
2. **Cubbes Support:** Full in-house support platform (React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, RAG) built across five surfaces (full admin platform, student mobile widget, website widget, lecturer platform, executive widget), avoiding a $900 third-party provider charge. Includes the Mo AI RAG agent with seamless human handoff.
3. **CampusLife:** Interactive 3D Nigerian university simulation in the browser (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js). Live at https://campuslife.cubbes.app/.
4. **Offline SMS Spam Classifier:** Compact offline ML spam filter (Python, scikit-learn, Kaggle) with data-processing scripts, baseline model, and training notebook.
5. **Open Source (Stellar & Soroban):** RPC failover for BACKit; attestation consent and compatibility tests for Soroban SAS; escrow testing, event processing, and refund logic across Stellar Bounty Board, Hamplard, and StreamPay.
